description: Here are some of my favorite ways that I used AI this week:  (Using ChatGPT, Claude, and Motion’s Runneth) 1. Using ChatGPT's new Work & Codex experience, finally (mostly) automated creative reporting deck making. 3 hours down to 20 minutes. THANK GOD.  Video on this soon ^ 2. Tons of Claude automations: a client watchdog report that pings me 2x per day to make sure no client Slacks are missed, a morning briefing that pre-writes email drafts + Slack messages that I have outstanding, a content idea generator from my Granola, and SO MUCH MORE.  3. And of course: Runneth. Listen: I'm incredibly biased but I am also incredibly impressed.  Some examples:  - Had it create an in-depth research analysis on IM8’s ad library. They currently have 3000 ads in rotation, so I wanted to understand their creative velocity, creator strategy, how they’re pressure testing with statics, etc. I gave Runneth 3 days to complete the report, made it double check it’s work twice and…. wow - Asked a few high-impact but one-off questions: think YES or NO answers. Has this brand ever run ads in Spanish before? Have they ever tested statics targeting this persona? Have they ever tried this kind of creator? Is there a mismatch between the age breakdown vs the people in the ads? I love doing this when onboarding new brands and I need a quick gut check on the strategy and suggestions I’m presenting.  - Do a persona analysis on these (give a list of 10-20) organic creatives. Who are they targeting? I know it might be BIG PERSONA GROUP, but what are the sub groups? ^ I liked doing this one because it told us more about the new people we needed to speak to vs our own website reviews or past creatives that had been tested.  - Run a comparison report for how our ads are doing vs the other agencies. Turn this into a dashboard.  - Explain why the performance dipped on THIS CREATIVE. Did it fatigue? Was there a bad comment that brought down performance? Did a metric like CTR or CPM worsen? We don't go by ROAS, we go by CPA and spend as the main metric of truth in this account, so please do not focus on ROAS. Tell me: what was something cool that you built this week??
transcript: So I have a creative strategist friend who charges 8K for a creative audit, and brands love them. They get a ton of value from them. But she said something crazy, which was that because of A I, it is actually taking her two to three times longer to make these reports because she has so much more data and insights to actually analyze. And I was like, finally someone said it. Because I have been getting this, like, fatigue lately where I'm like, oh, but what about this really fascinating insight? Does this fit into my overall hypothesis? And it's like, with that said, I feel like I've been getting to a really good place with my AI journey. Recently, I've been using Codex to make decks for clients and have that completely automated. I'm going to be sharing that really soon. I'm also using Claude to create a ton of animations that are pinging me every single day, surfacing really important Slack messages, writing drafts for emails. Really happy to share that too. And I've also been using motions you runneth tool a ton lately, and I gotta say, my team is obsessed. And I'm gonna give you a few examples of ways that I've used it actually over the last few weeks. Number one, we are currently on boarding a new brand and I had a few, like, one off questions like, I wonder if they've ever run ads in Spanish or I wonder if they've ever Run EGC before and using runneth I was able to ask those questions directly in Slack and have it give me a definitive yes or no answer for the last 365 days. What I really love too is it's been able to make some sexy research reports that I trust a lot more than the other automations that I've made in the past. Because runneth is actually able to to watch the videos inside of Ads library or even videos that you upload to it, right? A lot of times these LLMs will actually just look at the transcript. But no, runneth is actually looking at those videos frame by frame and can give a much better in depth analysis on the creative as a whole. I don't know! If any of this sounds interesting and you'd like me to dive deeper on any of these, let me know in the comments. I am feeling really good about where I'm getting with all this AI stuff lately and I'd love to share.
